item.ancient_extensions.pokeball_pouch.d: Dedicated Poké Ball storage — nothing else fits inside.
item.ancient_extensions.pokeball_pouch.p: Right-click to open · Place to set down on the ground.
item.ancient_extensions.regional_passpor: One permanent origin stamp — your region and hometown on every survey record.
item.ancient_extensions.shiny_charm.desc: A gleaming charm that raises your odds of finding shiny Pokémon when your Cobblemon dex is complete.
item.ancient_extensions.regional_survey_: The complete research log: rank, goals, rewards, and migration history.
item.ancient_extensions.field_survey_cal: Wall-mounted spawn guess for this exact block — planning only, not live data.
ancient_extensions.field_calendar.discla: Estimate only — based on migration spawn tables, not live field telemetry.
ancient_extensions.field_calendar.no_ser: Calendar data is only available on the server.
ancient_extensions.field_calendar.biome_: Could not read the biome at this calendar.
ancient_extensions.field_calendar.vanill: Vanilla biome — estimates use the closest seasonal route biomes for this climate.
ancient_extensions.field_calendar.no_sur: No featured survey species match this biome in the current season.
ancient_extensions.field_calendar.no_spa: No migratory spawn entries match this biome this season.
ancient_extensions.field_calendar.sensor: For live readouts, use a Field Survey Sensor with Create Display Links.
ancient_extensions.guide.field_calendar_: Uses spawn-table weights for this block — no live telemetry.
Pair with a sensor when you need authoritative Create readouts.
item.ancient_extensions.field_survey_sen: Live migration telemetry at this position — season, route leg, and species pool.
item.ancient_extensions.field_survey_mon: Four-line in-world board for Create Display Link output at camp.
ancient_extensions.field_sensor.hint_cre: Use a Create Display Link: target your monitor or sign, then place the link on this sensor. Choose a field source (season, biome, or species).
ancient_extensions.field_sensor.hint_no_: Install Create and craft this sensor with brass + your Field Survey Tablet to feed Display Links.
ancient_extensions.field_monitor.hint_cr: Use a Create Display Link: target this monitor, then place the link on a Field Survey Sensor.
ancient_extensions.field_monitor.hint_no: Install Create to display live migration readouts on this monitor.
item.ancient_extensions.field_survey_tel: Caches a mobile migration scan on the backpack while you wear it outdoors.
Install in a Sophisticated Backpack upgrade slot.
ancient_extensions.sb.telemetry.tooltip_: No readout yet — wear the backpack outdoors to scan.
ancient_extensions.sb.telemetry.conflict: Only one Field Survey Telemetry upgrade per backpack.
ancient_extensions.guide.sb_telemetry_de: Refreshes while worn outdoors — handy on the move, not a camp replacement.
Craft with a Sophisticated Backpacks upgrade base + Field Survey Tablet.
item.ancient_extensions.migration_route_: Points to the closest biome on your active migration leg while held.
ancient_extensions.compass.tooltip_use: Right-click to rescan · Sneak + use to pin on Xaero's map.
ancient_extensions.compass.on_route: You are on route at %s · leg %s/%s · %s/%s migratory catches
ancient_extensions.compass.not_found: No route biome found within range · leg %s/%s
ancient_extensions.compass.waypoint_tip: Sneak + use to add a Xaero's map waypoint for the locked target.
ancient_extensions.compass.waypoint_jm_h: JourneyMap fallback: click the line above to create a waypoint.
ancient_extensions.compass.waypoint_xaer: Install Xaero's Minimap or World Map for automatic waypoints.
ancient_extensions.guide.compass_detail1: Scans for the nearest biome on your current migration leg.
ancient_extensions.guide.compass_detail2: Needle stays locked while the compass is in your hand.
ancient_extensions.guide.compass_detail3: Sneak + use adds the locked target to Xaero's Minimap or World Map.
ancient_extensions.guide.field_sensor_de: Display Link sources: season, biome/route leg, species pool, route bearing.
Most accurate migration readout — calendar and backpack scans are estimates.
ancient_extensions.guide.field_monitor_d: Shows up to four linked lines on the block face.
Typical setup: sensor at the route stop, monitor on the camp board.
item.ancient_extensions.field_survey_tab: Quick field HUD — stats plus one-tap links to journal, passport, and chart.
ancient_extensions.tablet.welcome: You received a Field Survey Tablet—right-click it for live survey status and shortcuts.
ancient_extensions.tablet.empty: No survey data yet—catch Pokémon on your route to begin.
item.ancient_extensions.migration_route_: Route map for the current season — legs, your biome, and countable species.
ancient_extensions.guide.advanced_hint: Hold F3+H for more detail lines.
ancient_extensions.guide.field_calendar_: Place on a wall · Right-click to read the estimate.
ancient_extensions.guide.field_sensor_ac: Place at camp · Link with a Create Display Link.
ancient_extensions.guide.field_monitor_a: Place the board · Target it from a Display Link.
ancient_extensions.guide.chart_detail1: Updates when opened: season, active leg, biome, route list, and species.
ancient_extensions.guide.chart_detail2: Catch migratory Pokémon on the active leg to advance — Flying-types always count.
ancient_extensions.guide.chart_trade: Journeyman Cartographers sell one for 7 emeralds + a compass.
ancient_extensions.guide.journal_detail1: Pages cover research rank, active goals, migration legs, and unclaimed rewards.
ancient_extensions.guide.journal_detail2: Use Claim rank rewards when a tier is ready — not available on the tablet.
ancient_extensions.guide.journal_craft: Craft: paper above/below leather, ink sac on the bottom row.
ancient_extensions.guide.tablet_detail1: Shows live RP, rank, and field conditions without opening the full journal.
ancient_extensions.guide.tablet_detail2: Use this in the field; use the journal when you need every goal and reward line.
ancient_extensions.guide.passport_detail: Pick a Pokémon region, then a hometown — the choice cannot be changed later.
Your stamp appears on the journal and may show as a colored tag in multiplayer.
ancient_extensions.guide.passport_craft: Craft: regional survey journal in the center, paper on the sides, gold nugget above, leather below.
ancient_extensions.guide.kit_detail1: Single use: deploys fire, tent, bedroll, supply chest, and briefing lectern.
ancient_extensions.guide.kit_detail2: Also granted on first join. Craft: white wool, chest, journal, flint & steel, spruce planks.
ancient_extensions.guide.pouch_detail1: Craft with any Poké Ball in the center — the ball sets tier, look, and slot count.
ancient_extensions.migration_chart.toolt: Right-click to read the chart for where you are standing.
ancient_extensions.migration_chart.empty: No route data available. Stand in a loaded world and open the chart again.

ancient_extensions.jei.pokeball_pouch.st: String makes the shoulder strap on the top row.

ancient_extensions.region.kanto.blurb: The classic heartland—oak routes, league dreams, and endless tall grass.
ancient_extensions.region.johto.blurb: Legends linger among towers and quiet routes between mountains and sea.
ancient_extensions.region.hoenn.blurb: Land and sea intertwine; volcanic paths and tropical shores shape every survey.
ancient_extensions.region.sinnoh.blurb: Mythic peaks and harsh winters—migratory lines bend around Mount Coronet.
ancient_extensions.region.unova.blurb: Urban skylines and distant frontiers—contrasts that define modern field work.
ancient_extensions.region.kalos.blurb: Elegant valleys and radiant meadows where beauty and battle meet.
ancient_extensions.region.alola.blurb: Island chains and guardian spirits—every leg of migration crosses open ocean.
ancient_extensions.region.galar.blurb: Rolling wild areas and stadium culture—open moors host seasonal wanderers.
ancient_extensions.region.paldea.blurb: A vast open region—treasure hunts and terastal light guide surveyors inland.
ancient_extensions.advancement.research_: Rise through the research ranks by catching Pokémon in the field.
